ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future and Somali fraud investigations
questions: What are the financial connections between the defendants and other entities?
How did the fraud schemes work?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial trails of these cases, we may uncover patterns and connections that can help prevent future fraud. This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and negligence in the state's handling of funds.
